notes: AzCrash edge NPZ from Edge V1-V3, rows at velocities 0.27, 0.522 and 1.0 (each renders at its capture's level relative to the loudest: 0.224, 0.5, 1.0). velw: one set for every row, Edge V2's (the strongest partial within +-0.25 % of each mode, ^0.8), with the modes below 112 Hz weighted from the SPEAR energy within +-4 % of each mode frame by frame, so gliding low partials count; the sub-89 Hz and 89-112 Hz split set per row. Band envelopes in the plugin's 22 one-third-octave bands, 20 ms frames from the strike, built from the SPEAR band levels and then calibrated by rendering: per band and time window (0-0.2, 0.3-1.5, 1.5-4 s) until the plugin matched CrashSoft, CrashMedium and CrashLoud. Every row's envelope peaks at frame 1, band 7 (1.0), so blends of two rows keep their level (the engine normalises a blend by its peak). edge_rms_correction as built.
